profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Altamira Technologies Corporation
profile.summary: I have a strong work ethic, I have the ability to think outside the box, and I am always looking to challenge myself. And where I lack experience, I bring my quick learning skills to the table.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained and modernized a desktop application into a web based application. 
Work with a team in an agile setting deploying to cloud based solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: I have helped develop many dockerized micro services and a react based front end application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: TypeScript · Rti dds · Customer Support · Relational Databases · Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) · Hibernate · Docker Products · JavaScript · Problem Solving · Python (Programming Language) · Java · Interactive Applications · React.js · Gitlab

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description: Tested front-end and back-end functionality of web and desktop applications. Designed test plans, documented test cases, and created user guides. Identified defects and collaborated with developers for timely resolution.

positions.title: Computer Science Intern
positions.description: Developed a hybrid mobile app interfacing with device electronics and webserver communications. Collected sensor data (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, temperature, humidity, pressure) and geolocation. Created an HTML web page hosted on device and server for project deliverables.

positions.title: Test Engineer coop
positions.description: Testing the locks, to make sure they function correctly. I have helped make scripts for the automation of testing the locks work.

positions.title: Crew Member
positions.description: Training other employees, taking care of customers, working on a team, and ability to multitask in a timely manner

volunteerExperiences.description: I am a volunteer trainer through 4 paws for ability located in Xenia, Ohio. I help train and raise service dogs in training from when they are as young as 3 months to 2 years. I help socialize, teach them basic commands, and get them prepared for their task specific training.
